subtitle: Production-shaped Go RabbitMQ Consumer Boilerplate
description: A minimal, production-shaped GitHub template for a Go service that consumes messages from a RabbitMQ queue. Click 'Use this template', rename the module, and start writing business logic in a single, well-defined handler.

techStack.ci: GitHub Actions (build, vet, fmt, test, docker)

architectureHighlights.title: Graceful Shutdown
architectureHighlights.description: Listens for SIGINT/SIGTERM and lets in-flight deliveries finish before the process exits.

architectureHighlights.title: Automatic Reconnect
architectureHighlights.description: Connection and retry handling is delegated to wagslane/go-rabbitmq, with a configurable base reconnect delay.

architectureHighlights.title: Structured Logging
architectureHighlights.description: JSON logs via zerolog with size/age-based rotation and optional gzip compression through lumberjack.

modularInfrastructure.title: cmd/consumer
modularInfrastructure.description: Main package handling wiring, config loading, and OS signal handling.

modularInfrastructure.title: internal/rmq
modularInfrastructure.description: Connection setup, consumer loop, and a single Handler interface (defaultHandler.Process) as the extension point.

modularInfrastructure.title: internal/config & internal/model
modularInfrastructure.description: Typed env-var configuration and the message payload types to adapt for a real producer.

setupAndRun.step: Use this template on GitHub, then rename the module
Run with Docker (spins up RabbitMQ too)
Or run locally against your own broker
